1.1: Ketzad haedim naasim zommin, meidin anu veish peloni shehu ven gerusha o ven chalutza, en omrim yease ze ven gerusha o ven chalutza tachtav, ella loke arbaim. meidin anu veish peloni shehu chayyav liglot, en omrim yigle ze tachtav, ella loke arbaim. meidin anu veish peloni sheggerash et ishto velo natan lah ketubbatah, vahalo ben hayyom uven lemachar sofo litten lah ketubbatah, omdin kamma adam rotze litten bichtubbatah shel zo, sheim nitalmena o nitgarsha, veim meta yirashenna valah. meidin anu veish peloni shehu chayyav lachavero elef zuz al menat littenan lo mikkan vead sheloshim yom, vehu omer mikkan vead eser shanim, omdin kamma adam rotze litten veyihyu veyado elef zuz, ben notnan mikkan vead sheloshim yom, ben notnan mikkan vead eser shanim:
1.2: Meidin anu veish peloni shechayyav lachavero matayim zuz, venimtzeu zommin, lokin umeshallemin, shello hashshem hamevio lide makkot, mevio lide tashlumin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kol hameshallem eno loke:
1.3: Meidin anu veish peloni shehu chayyav malkut arbaim, venimtzeu zommin, lokin shemonim, mishshum lo taane vereacha ed shaker (Shemot 20), umishshum vaasitem lo kaasher zamam (Devarim 19), divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, enan lokin ella arbaim. meshalleshin bemamon veen meshalleshin bemakkot. ketzad, heiduhu shehu chayyav lachavero matayim zuz, venimtzeu zommin, meshalleshin benehem. aval im heiduhu shehu chayyav malkut arbaim, venimtzeu zommin, kol echad veechad loke arbaim:
1.4: En haedim naasim zommin ad sheyyazomu et atzman. ketzad, amru meidin anu veish peloni sheharag et hannefesh, amru lahen heach attem meidin, shehare neherag ze o hahoreg haya immanu oto hayyom bemakom peloni, en ellu zommin. aval amru lahem heach attem meidin, shehare attem heyitem immanu oto hayyom bemakom peloni, hare ellu zommin, veneheragin al pihem:
1.5: Bau acherim vehizzimum, bau acherim vehizzimum, afillu mea, kullam yeharegu. rabbi yehuda omer, istasit hi zo, veenah nehereget ella chat harishona vilvad:
1.6: En haedim zommin neheragin, ad sheyyiggamer haddin, shehare hatztzedokin omrim, ad sheyyehareg, shenneemar nefesh tachat nafesh. amru lahem chachamim, vahalo chevar neemar (Devarim 19) vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv, vahare achiv kayyam. veim ken lamma neemar nefesh tachat nafesh, yachol mishshaa shekkibbelu edutan yeharegu, talmud lomar, nefesh tachat nafesh, ha enan neheragin ad sheyyiggamer haddin:
1.7: Al pi shenayim edim o shelosha edim yumat hammet (sham 17), im mitkayyemet haedut bishnayim, lamma farat hakkatuv bishlosha, ella lehakkish shelosha lishnayim, ma shelosha mazzimin et hashshenayim, af hashshenayim yazommo et hashshelosha. uminnayin afillu mea, talmud lomar, edim. rabbi shimon omer, ma shenayim enan neheragin ad sheyyehu shenehem zommin, af shelosha enan neheragin ad sheyyihyu shelashtan zommin. uminnayin afillu mea, talmud lomar, edim. rabbi akiva omer, lo va hashshelishi ella lehachemir alav velaasot dino chayyotze vaellu. veim ken anash hakkatuv lannitpal leovre avera cheovre avera, al achat kamma vechamma yeshallem sachar lannitpal leose mitzva cheose mitzva:
1.8: Ma shenayim nimtza achad mehen karov o fasul edutan betela, af shelosha nimtza echad mehen karov o fasul, edutan betela. minnayin afillu mea, talmud lomar, edim. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, bedine nefashot. aval bedine mamonot, titkayyem haedut bashshear. rabbi omer, echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot. bizman shehitru vahen, aval bizman shello hitru vahen, ma yaasu shene achin sherau veechad sheharag et hannafesh:
1.9: Hayu shenayim roin oto mechallon ze ushenayim roin oto mechallon ze veechad matre vo baemtza, bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu, hare ellu edut achat. veim lav, hare ellu shete eduyyot. lefichach im nimtzet achat mehen zomemet, hu vahen neheragin vehashsheniyya petura. rabbi yose omer, leolam en neheragin ad sheyyehu pi shene edav matrin bo, shenneemar (Devarim 17) al pi shenayim edim. davar acher, al pi shenayim edim, shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturgeman:
1.10: Mi shennigmar dino uvarach uva lifne oto vet din, en sotrim et dino. kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru, meidin anu veish peloni shennigmar dino bevet dino shel peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav, hare ze yehareg. sanhedrin noheget baaretz uvechutza laaretz. sanhedrin hahoreget echad beshavua nikret chavlanit. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, echad leshivim shana. rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva omrim, illu hayinu vassanhedrin lo neherag adam meolam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af hen marbin shofche damim beyisrael:

2.1: Ellu hen haggolin, hahoreg nefesh bishgaga. haya meaggel bemagila venafla alav vaharagattu, haya meshalshel bechavit venafla alav vaharagattu, haya yored besullam venafal alav vaharago, hare ze gole. aval im haya moshech bemagila venafla alav vaharagattu, haya dole vechavit venifsak hachevel venafla alav vaharagattu, haya ole vesullam venafal alav vaharago, hare ze eno gole. ze hakkelal, kol shebbederech yeridato, gole. veshello vederech yeridato, eno gole. nishmat habbarzel mikkatto veharag, rabbi omer, eno gole. vachachamim omrim, gole. min haetz hammitbakkea, rabbi omer, gole. vachachamim omrim, eno gole:
2.2: Hazzorek even lirshut harabbim veharag, hare ze gole. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, im mikkesheyyatzta haeven miyyado hotzi hallaz et rosho vekibbelah, hare ze fatur. zarak et haeven lachatzero veharag, im yesh reshut lannizzak likkanes lesham, gole. veim lav, eno gole, shenneemar (Devarim 19) vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar, ma hayyaar reshut lannizzak velammazzik likkanes lesham, yatza chatzar baal habbayit sheen reshut lannizzak velammazzik likkanes lesham. abba shaul omer, ma chatavat etzim reshut, yatza haav hammakke et beno, veharav harode et talmido, usheliach bet din:
2.3: Haav gole al yede habben, vehabben gole al yede haav. hakkol golin al yede yisrael, veyisrael golin al yedehen, chutz meal yede ger toshav. veger toshav eno gole ella al yede ger toshav. hassuma eno gole, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, gole. hassone eno gole. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, hassone neherag, mippene shehu chemuad. rabbi shimon omer, yesh sone gole veyesh sone sheeno gole. ze hakkelal, kol shehu yachol lomar ledaat harag, eno gole. veshello ledaat harag, hare ze gole:
2.4: Lehechan golin, leare miklat. lashshalosh shebbeever hayyarden velashshalosh shebbeeretz kenaan, shenneemar (Bamidbar la) et shelosh hearim tittenu meever layyarden veet shelosh hearim tittenu beeretz kenaan vegomer. ad shello nivcharu shalosh shebbeeretz yisrael, lo hayu shalosh shebbeever hayyarden koltot, shenneemar (sham) shesh are miklat tihyena, ad sheyyihyu sheshtan koltot keechad:
2.5: Umechuvvanot lahen derachim mizzo lazo, shenneemar (Devarim 19) tachin lecha hadderech veshillashta vegomer. umosrin lahen shene talmide chachamim, shemma yahargennu vadderech, vidabberu elav. rabbi meir omer, af hu medabber al yede atzmo, shenneemar (sham) veze devar harotzeach:
2.6: Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, battechilla, echad shogeg veechad mezid makdimin leare miklat, uvet din sholchin umeviin oto mishsham. mi shennitchayyev mita bevet din, haraguhu. veshello nitchayyev mita, petaruhu. mi shennitchayyev galut, machazirin oto limkomo, shenneemar (Bamidbar la) veheshivu oto haeda el ir miklato vegomer. echad mashuach beshemen hammishcha veechad hamerubbe vivgadim veechad sheavar mimmeshichato, machazirin et harotzeach. rabbi yehuda omer, af meshuach milchama machazir et harotzeach. lefichach immotehen shel kohanim mesappekot lahen michya uchesut, kede shello yitpallelu al benehem sheyyamutu. mishshennigmar dino met kohen gadol, hare ze eno gole. im ad shello nigmar dino met kohen gadol uminnu acher tachtav, uleachar mikken nigmar dino, chozer bemitato shel sheni:
2.7: Nigmar dino velo chohen gadol, hahoreg kohen gadol, vechohen gadol sheharag, eno yotze mishsham leolam. veeno yotze lo leedut mitzva velo leedut mamon velo leedut nefashot. vaafillu yisrael tzerichim lo, vaafillu sar tzeva yisrael keyoav ben tzeruya, eno yotze mishsham leolam, shenneemar (Bamidbar la) asher nas shamma, sham tehe dirato, sham tehe mitato, sham tehe kevurato. keshem shehair koletet, kach techumah kolet. rotzeach sheyyatza chutz lattechum umetzao goel haddam, rabbi yose haggelili omer, mitzva veyad goel haddam, ureshut beyad kol adam. rabbi akiva omer, reshut beyad goel haddam, vechol adam en chayyavin alav. ilan shehu omed betoch hattechum venofo note chutz lattechum, o omed chutz lattechum venofo note letoch hattechum, hakkol holech achar hannof. harag beotah hair, gole mishshechuna lishchuna. uven levi, gole meir leir:
2.8: Kayyotze vo, rotzeach sheggala leir miklato veratzu anshe hair lechabbedo, yomar lahem rotzeach ani. amru lo af al pi chen, yekabbel mehen, shenneemar (Devarim 19) veze devar harotzeach. maalim hayu sachar lalviyyim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, lo hayu maalim lahen sachar. vechozer lasserara shehaya vah, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya chozer lasserara shehaya vah:

3.1: Veellu hen hallokin, habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal hannidda, almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer. almana ugerusha, chayyavin aleha mishshum shene shemot. gerusha vachalutza, eno chayyav ella mishshem echad bilvad:
3.2: Hattame sheachal et hakkodesh, vehabba el hammikdash tame, vehaochel chelev, vedam, venotar, ufiggul, vetame, hashshochet vehammaale vachutz, vehaochel chametz befesach, vehaochel vehaose melacha beyom hakkippurim, vehamefattem et hashshemen, vehamefattem et hakketoret, vehassach beshemen hammishcha, vehaochel nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim. achal tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. kamma yochal min hattevel vihe chayyav, rabbi shimon omer kol shehu, vachachamim omrim kazzayit. amar lahem rabbi shimon, en attem modim li beochel nemala kol shehu chayyav. amru lo, mippene shehi chivriyyatah. amar lahen, af chitta achat kivriyyatah:
3.3: Haochel bikkurim ad shello kara alehen, kadshe kadashim chutz lakkelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni chutz lachoma, hashshover et haetzem bappesach hattahor, hare ze loke arbaim. aval hammotir battahor vehashshover battame, eno loke arbaim:
3.4: Hannotel em al habbanim, rabbi yehuda omer, loke veeno meshalleach. vachachamim omrim, meshalleach veeno loke. ze hakkelal, kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase, en chayyavin aleha:
3.5: Hakkoreach karcha verosho, vehammakkif peat rosho, vehammashchit peat zekano, vehassoret serita achat al hammet, chayyav. sarat serita achat al chamishsha metim o chamesh seritot al met echad, chayyav al kol achat veechat. al harosh, shetayim, achat mikkan veachat mikkan. al hazzakan, shetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan veachat millematta. rabbi eliezer omer, im netalo chullo cheachat, eno chayyav ella echat. veeno chayyav ad sheyyittelennu vetaar. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu likketo vemalket o virhitni, chayyav:
3.6: Hakkotev ketovet kaaka, katav velo kiaka, kiaka velo chatav, eno chayyav, ad sheyyichtov vikaakea bidyo uvichchol uvechol davar shehu roshem. rabbi shimon ben yehuda mishshum rabbi shimon omer, eno chayyav ad sheyyichtov sham hashshem, shenneemar (Vayikra 19) uchetovet kaaka lo tittenu bachem ani Adonai:
3.7: Nazir shehaya shote vayyayin kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tishte al tishte vehu shote, chayyav al kol achat veechat:
3.8: Haya mittamme lemetim kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tittamme, al tittamme, vehaya mittamme, chayyav al kol achat veechat. haya megalleach kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tegalleach al tegalleach vehu megalleach, chayyav al kol achat veechat. haya lavush bechilayim kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tilbash al tilbash vehu foshet velovesh, chayyav al kol achat veechat:
3.9: Yesh choresh telem echad vechayyav alav mishshum shemona lavin, hachoresh beshor vachamor, vehen mukdashim, bechilayim bakkerem, uvashsheviit, veyom tov, vechohen venazir bevet hattuma. chananya ben chachinay omer, af hallovesh kilayim. amru lo, eno hashshem. amar lahem, af lo hannazir hu hashshem:
3.10: Kamma malkin oto, arbaim chaser achat. shenneemar (Devarim 25) bemispar arbaim, minyan shehu samuch learbaim. rabbi yehuda omer, arbaim shelemot hu loke. vehechan hu loke et hayetera, ben ketefav:
3.11: En omdin oto ella vemakkot haruyot lehishtallesh. amaduhu lekabbel arbaim, laka miktzat veamru sheeno yachol lekabbel arbaim, patur. amaduhu lekabbel shemone esre, mishshellaka amru sheyyachol hu lekabbel arbaim, patur. avar avera sheyyesh bah shene lavin, amaduhu omed echad, loke ufatur. veim lav, loke umitrappe vechozer veloke:
3.12: Ketzad malkin oto, kofet shete yadav al haammud helach vehelach, vechazzan hakkeneset ochez bivgadav, im nikreu nikrau, veim nifremu niframu, ad shehu megalle et libbo. vehaeven netuna meacharav, chazzan hakkeneset omed aleha. uretzua shel egel beyado, kefula echad lishnayim ushenayim learbaa, ushete retzuot olot veyordot bah:
3.13: Yadah tefach verachbah tefach, veroshah maggaat al pi chereso. umakke oto shelish millefanav ushete yadot milleacharav. veeno makke oto lo omed velo yoshev ella mutte, shenneemar (Devarim 25) vehippilo hashshofet. vehammakke makke veyado achat bechol kocho:
3.14: Vehakkore kore (sham 28) im lo tishmor laasot vegomer vehifla Adonai et makkotcha veet makkot vegomer, vechozer litchillat hammikra (sham 29) ushemartem et divre habberit hazzot vegomer, vechotem (tehillim 78) vehu rachum yechapper avon vegomer, vechozer litchillat hammikra. veim met tachat yado, patur. hosif lo od retzua achat vamet, hare ze gole al yado. nitkalkel ben berei ben bemayim, patur. rabbi yehuda omer, haish berei vehaishsha bemayim:
3.15: Kol chayyave cheretot shellaku, nifteru yede cheretatan, sheneemar (Devarim 25) venikla achicha leenecha, keshellaka hare hu cheachicha, divre rabbi chananya ben gamliel. amar rabbi chananya ben gamliel, ma im haover avera achat, notel nafsho aleha, haose mitzva achat, al achat kamma vechamma shettinnaten lo nafsho. rabbi shimon omer, mimmekomo hu lamed, shenneemar (Vayikra 18) venichretu hannefashot haosot vegomer, veomer (sham) asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem. ha, kol hayyoshev velo avar avera, notnin lo sachar keose mitzva. rabbi shimon bar rabbi omer, hare hu omer (Devarim 12) rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh vegomer, uma im haddam shennafsho shel adam katza mimmennu, happoresh mimmennu mekabbel sachar, gazel vaarayot shennafsho shel adam mitavva lahen umechammadtan, happoresh mehen al achat kamma vechamma sheyyizke lo uledorotav uledorot dorotav ad sof kol haddorot:
3.16: Rabbi chananya ben akashya omer, ratza hakkadosh baruch hu lezakkot et yisrael, lefichach hirba lahem tora umitzvot, shenneemar (yeshaya 42) Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir:
